t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone ground. Small sans eyebrow and a very large light-weight navy sans-serif headline in sentence case across the top, with a small subhead. Left: a duotone navy and limestone macro close-up of a pipe running diagonally with a raised fusion bead ring, soft tonal shading, shallow depth of field, overlaid with hairline dimension tick scales and leader lines, cropped by the frame. Right: an open-sided three-column table with hairline rules and numbered rows for <CONTENT>. Square corners, no accent colour, calm and precise.
signature_idea: A duotone macro of a single fusion joint, annotated with hairline tick scales, sits beside the stage-by-stage document table like a figure in a technical paper.
strengths: the joint macro shows the actual craft of PP fusion, not generic equipment
duotone navy and limestone keeps the image calm and on-palette
light headline and plain hairline table are clear and buildable
image cropping gives the section a confident editorial feel
weaknesses: leader lines and tick scales point to nothing and carry no labels, so they are decorative
bead reads like a metal weld collar more than a PP butt-fusion bead
table is plain and dense with small body text, the visual idea lives only in the image
no mono for codes or clause numbers where the brand expects it
invented clause references in the cells must not be read as facts
brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone duotone, light headline, square corners and hairline rules fit, but there is no mono or accent and the annotations are decorative.
